author: GoPro
description:
GoPro MISSION 1 PRO ILS is here 🎥 We added a Micro Four Thirds lens mount to the world's smallest mirrorless cinema camera. Industry-leading frame rates and resolutions combine with pro focus and cinematic depth of field—all on a new 1-inch Quad Bayer sensor capable of 8K Open Gate capture.

Nothing on the market rivals this level of affordability, versatility, and performance.

✔️ Compatibility with over 300 lenses
✔️ Free MISSION Monitor app with advanced focus peaking, LUT previews + zebra patterns
✔️ Focus assist (up to 8x magnification) + focus peaking on rear OLED screen
✔️ 8K60, 4K240, 1440p480, + 1080p960 slo-mo with real frames—no AI-interpolation
✔️ Cinema-grade 8K30 + 4K120 Open Gate capture
✔️ Up to 14 stops of dynamic range at the sensor
✔️ New proprietary GP3 processor for highly-efficient, intelligent processing
✔️ 10-Bit color + GP-Log2 with LUTs for Rec.709 + Rec.2020 outputs
✔️ HLG HDR with Simultaneous Dual-Gain Readout for single-exposure highlight + shadow detail
title: This is GoPro MISSION 1 PRO ILS
